listing: Long post, sorry! I'm leaving for a co-op in Calgary and my room in our friendly 6-person house near both campuses is open Jan 1 to Apr 30. Rent is $575/month plus an equal share of utilities (last winter that was about $48 each). Big kitchen, 2 bathrooms, backyard, everyone's a student. Rent is paid by e-transfer on the 1st of each month to the head tenant and you get a receipt. We'd love to meet you before anyone commits - come by for dinner or tea! Happy to answer questions about the landlord, who is responsive when things break (heater fixed in 2 days last Feb). The landlord's consent to the sublet is requested and he's usually fine with it. 17 Lester St, Waterloo.
label_rationale: Chatty, long, wholesome. Contains words a naive scam model might key on (e-transfer, 'before anyone commits', 'sorry') but all are benign. ADMIT.
